title: The Endless Night — three new allies, direct ally control, and redesigned spell cards
author: Spytle
selftext:
Hi again! It’s been about a month since my last update here, and **The Endless Night** has grown quite a bit.

Allies are no longer mostly automatic. You can now decide when and how they use key abilities, making healing, targeting, defense, and formation part of your strategy.

The roster also adds three new allies:

* **The Masked Vigilante**
* **The Mayor**
* **The Mob Boss**

Existing allies received new abilities and reworks too, including player-controlled Defib and Triage for the Paramedic, Overwatch for SWAT, and a multi-target Open Fire volley for the Beat Cop.

Spell cards have also been redesigned for clearer combos and effects. Volatile sigils now have expanded mechanics and presentation, Lightning and Cosmic familiars have joined the progression, and late-game ritual pressure received a balance pass.

AI was especially helpful in getting this update together. I used **ChatGPT image generation** and **Photoshop’s Generative Fill** to create new card-design elements, adapt existing artwork to the new format, and bring the cards closer to a consistent visual style.

On the code side, I used **ChatGPT Codex in Visual Studio Code** to help build the new ally-control system after receiving player feedback. I still designed the mechanics, directed the presentation, tested the results, and made the final calls, but the AI-assisted workflow helped me turn that feedback into a playable update much faster.

That ability to respond and iterate quickly has become one of the most useful parts of the process for me as a solo developer.

The free demo and full build are available here:

[https://theendlessnight.itch.io/the-endless-night](https://theendlessnight.itch.io/the-endless-night)

The full breakdown is in Dev Log 11:

[https://theendlessnight.itch.io/the-endless-night/devlog/1613450/dev-log-11-new-allies-new-levels-of-control](https://theendlessnight.itch.io/the-endless-night/devlog/1613450/dev-log-11-new-allies-new-levels-of-control)

I’d love to hear whether the new ally controls make combat feel more tactical.
